title: update_index --workers crashes with AttributeError on Django >= 4.1 when a DB alias is unused
author: DhavalGojiya
body_preview: - [x] Tested with the latest Haystack release - [ ] Tested with the current Haystack master branch (not run, but `update_index.py` on `master` is identical to `v3.4.0`)  ## Expected behaviour  `update_index -k N` indexes in N worker processes, the same as `-k 0` does in one process.  ## Actual behaviour  Every worker fails when `DATABASES` has an alias that was not accessed in the parent process:...
